Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: clean production travel photograph for synchronized video framing previews.
Primary request: Independently create a realistic seaside creator photograph matching this approved scene: a creator viewed from behind filming a Mediterranean cove with a small handheld camera.

Subject: One adult creator seen from behind, brown hair in a loose bun, white short-sleeve shirt and plain black backpack, holding a compact unbranded camera on a handheld grip toward the cove.
Style/medium: Natural editorial travel photography, realistic rock and fabric textures, crisp optical detail.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 source photograph. Keep the creator near the horizontal center, within the central 30 percent of the frame so a center portrait crop retains the head, camera, shoulders and backpack. Rear eye-level view, creator in the lower middle foreground; generous turquoise water and warm cliffs extend to both sides. Enough vertical room above the head and below the backpack for portrait, landscape and square crops from one source.
Lighting/mood: Crisp clear midday sunshine, natural shadows, bright welcoming daylight.

Constraints: This is a raw photograph only. Full bleed scene. No interface, no cards, no borders, no rounded corners, no perspective transforms, no captions, no logos, no typography, no watermark. Generate original scene pixels independently; do not crop or reproduce UI screenshot pixels.
Avoid: extra people, invented props, sunset lighting, artificial purple tint, illustration, excessive HDR, blurry image, letterboxing, baked overlays.
